observations.statement: From H030 onward, every admitted hypothesis must state a proof_role and a next_gate; survival alone is no longer sufficient for admission.
observations.support: The schema and validator enforce these fields for hypothesis numbers 30 and above.

observations.statement: A direct target, a bridge lemma, an adversarial refutation route, and a barrier-breaking lemma are scientifically different roles and must not be described as equivalent progress.
observations.support: C006 labels each route explicitly and records its exact downstream theorem.

observations.statement: Short proof existence, deterministic proof verification, and polynomial-time proof search are three separate obligations.
observations.support: H046 is stronger than H025 because it requires all three, while attacks record the PIT and automatability gaps.

observations.statement: Deterministic isolation is not a SAT algorithm unless isolated residuals can also be recognized and solved deterministically.
observations.support: H000-G11 is rejected and H047 contains the missing tractability and recovery clauses.

observations.statement: A polynomial nonuniform lower bound for one explicit NP language directly implies P != NP, while lower bounds for exponential-time classes are only intermediate progress.
observations.support: H030 is a direct target; H057 is explicitly labeled an algorithmic lower-bound route.

observations.statement: A superpolynomial lower bound for any Cook-Reckhow proof system on an explicit tautology family implies NP != coNP, but lower bounds for restricted fragments need separate simulation arguments.
observations.support: H033-H038 separate the exact proof system and bridge assumptions.

observations.statement: Representation closure under projection or forgetting is a decisive attack tool: auxiliary variables help only when the target lower-bound language is not preserved by forgetting.
observations.support: The H016 refutation and H050 both use this distinction.

observations.statement: A finite local grammar is meaningful only when its semantic closure class is characterized; locality by itself does not exclude hidden general computation.
observations.support: H043-H045 specify target closure theorems and H000-G18 is rejected.

observations.statement: Mutually incompatible hypotheses may both be useful when they define the exact theorem needed to close a frontier, but each must name the experiment or theorem that resolves the pair.
observations.support: C006 preserves constructive and adversarial routes while assigning next gates.

observations.statement: C006 screened forty-two candidate formulations, rejected twelve before admission, and retained thirty only after sixty explicit attacks.
